questions.stem: Which statement best defines Pre-production?

options.text: It is the planning phase before filming, covering script, casting, and scheduling.
It is the principal phase in which the film is actually photographed.

questions.stem: In the era of celluloid, the unedited prints from a day's shoot were projected for the director. What were they called?

options.text: The concept of Dailies
The concept of Production
The concept of Post-production
The concept of Storyboard
